multiple_testing.within_family_adjustment: Holm step-down separately within discovery, validation and OOS
multiple_testing.broader_adjustment: Bonferroni across the 42 individual configurations and 4 fixed fusion candidates
multiple_testing.interpretation: Fixed-mix OOS results are exploratory. A within-four Holm result does not remove prior strategy-selection bias; the broader family correction is the conservative cross-candidate screen.

stage_multiple_testing.adjustment: Bonferroni across individual configurations for Top20 5-of-5, separately overall and by chronological split

constrained_multiple_testing.within_family_adjustment: Holm across four fixed constrained mixes x Top10/Top5 5-of-5 endpoints, separately within each chronological split
constrained_multiple_testing.broader_adjustment: Bonferroni across 42 individual Top20 configurations, 4 unconstrained fusions and 8 constrained Top10/Top5 endpoints
constrained_multiple_testing.interpretation: The legacy Top20 candidate set is held constant. Within-family signals are exploratory and broader correction plus prior strategy selection must be considered.
